# Metadata
> Multi-vertical public metadata API for agents and apps (anime, manga, light novels, games, cartoons, comics, POD, TCG, figures, model kits, plush, board games, fashion, OST, consoles, esports).

Base: https://metadata.fyi (local: http://127.0.0.1:8787)
Header: X-Metadata-Vertical: {anime|manga|lightnovels|game|cartoons|comics|pod|tcg|figures|modelkits|plush|boardgames|fashion|ost|consoles|esports}
Also: host {vertical}.metadata.fyi or ?vertical=
Schemas: docs/SCHEMAS.md

## Start here (agents)
- /SKILL.md — when and how to call Metadata
- /llms-full.txt — full endpoint map
- /openapi.json — machine-readable route list
- /.well-known/ai-plugin.json — plugin-style discovery
- /v1/verticals — live verticals + counts
- /v1/health — liveness for active vertical
- /v1/sku/{key} — resolve a SKU / style code / collector key (200 unique, 409 ambiguous, 404)
- POST /v1/sku/resolve — same resolver; use this for namespaced URIs (colons)

## Humans
- / — hub (vertical selector)
- /docs.html — playground
- /pricing.html — credit packs
- /stats.html — public platform traffic
- /legal.html — terms / privacy
- /feedback.html — flag bad data

## Core API
- GET /v1/sku/{key} — SKU resolve (200 unique / 409 ambiguous / 404). POST /v1/sku/resolve `{key}` or `{keys}` (max 20) for namespaced URIs (Cloudflare rejects colons in GET paths). Batch is HTTP 200 `{ results }`.
- GET /v1/datasets · GET /v1/datasets/{id} · GET /v1/export/dataset/{id} (prepaid identity summary)
- GET /v1/search?q=
- GET /v1/series · /v1/series/{id} · /v1/characters/{id}
- GET /v1/products · /v1/print-methods (pod)
- GET /v1/tcg/cards · /v1/tcg/sets
- GET /v1/market/coverage · /v1/market/status · /v1/market/search · /v1/market/items/{id} · /v1/market/quotes/{id} · /v1/market/history/{id} — quotes are venue medians (`confidence`), not solds
- GET|POST /mcp — MCP streamable HTTP (Muse, Phantasy, Claude). GET /.well-known/mcp.json
- GET /v1/figures/items · /v1/modelkits/items · /v1/plush/items
- GET /v1/boardgames · /v1/ost/albums · /v1/consoles
- GET /v1/esports/titles|leagues|teams|players
- GET /v1/stats — platform metrics (no addresses)
- POST /feedback — corrections queue (not catalog write)
- POST /v1/contribute — suggest rows (queued)

## Auth & billing
- Free **preview** (teaser): fixed sample per vertical in production at GET /v1/preview; arbitrary queries require payment. Development/staging use an IP quota.
- Full catalog: prepaid credits + X-Wallet-Address + X-Metadata-Session (balance > 0). Sign GET /v1/pay/auth/nonce then POST /v1/pay/auth/verify. Successful catalog reads debit at least 1 credit per returned data unit; response bytes and export minimums can increase the charge.
- Discovery (health, verticals, preview, SKILL, payment packs/quote/methods, feedback) open without credits; Stripe Checkout and wallet accounts require a signed session
- Pay: GET /v1/pay/quote · POST /v1/pay/claim (no session) · Stripe/Reown — see SKILL.md + docs/ACCESS.md
- x402: optional X-PAYMENT on zero-cost catalog reads when X402_ENABLED; exports remain prepaid-only

## Notes
- Public-internet metadata only; see /legal.html
- Flag errors via POST /feedback — do not invent silent fixes
